headline: An organization that can act without losing accountability.
lede: Ateles is designed so humans and agents can initiate, execute, review, and approve work together.

items.title: Name the roles
items.body: Every participant has a responsibility and a relationship to the people and work around it.

items.title: Carry the reason
items.body: Work arrives with the goal and priorities that explain why it matters.

items.title: Bound the action
items.body: Safe work advances; consequential work stops with the person entitled to decide.

items.title: Keep accountability
items.body: The result remains attributable to the role that acted and the person it acted for.
